description:
[read-only] A campaign's pieces grouped into review sections (episode, week, channel set, variant group or the creator's own). Each piece has preview URLs (video / images / audio), caption, labels, its bookings (channels, time, review state) and QA checks; each section has its status, round and every previous fix note. Share `reviewUrl` so a person can preview and decide in flayr.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaigns/{id}/review.)
name: get_campaign_review
title: Get a campaign's review sections
